name: SWE-bench Verified narration-policy ablation
objective: Test whether intermediate progress narration is a primary cause of the observed Codex-versus-DSH output-token and latency difference while holding model, tasks, coding capabilities, KB availability, filesystem-search backend, and validation requirements fixed within each harness.

arms.narration: system-prompt plugin requiring one short sentence before tool calls

matched_controls.workspace: clean detached worktree at the task base commit
matched_controls.kb_contract: same optional techdocs composite tool and skill
matched_controls.task_prompt: same SWE-bench issue and concise-final requirement

execution.pairing: All four arms run every task.
execution.order: Four-arm order rotates by task index.

interpretation.supports_narration_hypothesis: Suppressing Codex narration materially lowers output/latency and forcing DSH narration materially raises them without reducing official resolution.
interpretation.rejects_narration_as_primary: Narration changes visible prose but leaves most of the output-token and latency gap intact.
